manual.current_transformer.line2: The Current Transformer is a measurement device for electrical throughput.{0}
manual.current_transformer.line3: It can be hooked up in any powerline and will keep track of energy transferred through it, returning an average Flux/t upon rightclick.{0}
manual.current_transformer.line4: If a comparator is attached to the base of the transformer, it will output a signal from 0-15 depending upon the fill ratio of the wire's maximum transfer rate.
